summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting 2Q26 results and announcing that its Board of Directors approved US$1.7 billion in dividends and interest on capital, and extended its share buyback program. The company repurchased US$140 million of shares during the quarter. The filing is a routine earnings report from a foreign private issuer, but the explicit board-approved capital return actions — dividends and buyback extension — constitute a capital returns special situation. No price per share, premium, or deal structure was disclosed; the focus is on the aggregate dividend amount and ongoing buyback. Watch for further details on buyback size and execution pace.
